name: 連絡先の配信同意・ワークフロー一括操作メニュー
prompt:
Recreate only the HubSpot bulk-action menu shown in the primary original crop. Match the 420:347 aspect ratio (about 1.21:1), white popover with a thin light-gray outline, subtle shadow, rounded corners and the small upward callout pointer near the upper left. Preserve the six item rows and source spacing. No Japanese mock exists; use the source as the geometry authority and localize the labels.

From top to bottom, show exactly these six actions: a dark sparkle icon and 「データ補完の充足状況を確認」; a dark list icon and 「静的リストに追加」; no icon and 「ワークフローに登録」; no icon and pale disabled text 「コンタクトデータ処理の法的根拠を追加」; a plus icon and 「コミュニケーション配信設定を編集」; no icon and pale disabled text 「ダブルオプトインの状態を更新」. Keep the enabled rows in dark gray and both disabled rows visibly low-contrast gray-blue. Only the first, second and fifth rows have icons, aligned in the same narrow left column. Preserve the roomy vertical row spacing, consistent left text alignment and menu padding. Do not add a menu heading, extra actions, separators, checkmarks or controls.
reviewNotes: LH09-0262 v001 compared side by side with the original menu crop. It preserves six actions and the two disabled states. Defects: it adds a second sparkle, shifts icon-free rows into the icon text column, and renders the popover smaller than the source crop with outer canvas margins. Status: needs-correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
